v1.feedback: The tambour-embroidery concept maps well — the French-drum double meaning drives both the tension-flatten cycle and the chain-stitch overlay, and the copper-on-linen palette is exactly the restrained earth-tone register this gallery rewards. The chain-stitch detection via three overlapping parametric curves (radial veins, concentric rings, spiral chains) is genuinely inventive shader work. Two refinements: the spiral chain `fract(th2/(6.2832)+r2*.18-t*.02)` could use a slight thickness modulation along its length to better evoke actual looped thread rather than a uniform stroke; and the bloom-pass copper glow during tension risks reading as a flat overlay — consider making it travel along the stitch paths (e.g., a propagating wavefront from center outward) so the tension event feels like thread heating under pull rather than a global color shift.
